Mithrim

Fingolfin's town on the north shore of Lake Mithrim, in the first years of the Sun

08:00Morning · Day 1
Fingolfin's host by Lake Mithrim, the Fëanorians on the southern shore, Maedhros's rescue and the healing of the feud come from The Silmarillion; the open town, its hall, the quays, the market and the steadings are this map's interpretation.
